{{< include /knowledge/includes/setup-parameters.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    COLOR_BLACK,
    COLOR_WHITE,
    add_png_metadata,
    add_watermark,
    clean_spines,
    get_figure_output_path,
    setup_chart_style,
)
from dih_models.parameters import format_parameter_value

setup_chart_style()

budget_hours = {
    "Estimated US military\noverspend": float(STATE_RTT_US_MILITARY_OVERSPEND_EQUIVALENT_HOURS),
    "NIH annual budget": float(STATE_RTT_NIH_BUDGET_EQUIVALENT_HOURS),
    "FDA annual\nprogram budget": float(STATE_RTT_FDA_BUDGET_EQUIVALENT_HOURS),
}

names = list(budget_hours)
values = list(budget_hours.values())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.5))
bars = ax.barh(
    names,
    values,
    color=COLOR_WHITE,
    edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK,
    linewidth=2,
    hatch=["///", "...", ""],
)
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.invert_yaxis()

for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
    label = f"{value * 60:.0f} minutes" if value < 1 else f"{value:.1f} hours"
    ax.text(
        value * 1.2,
        bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2,
        label,
        va="center",
        ha="left",
        fontsize=12,
        weight="bold",
    )

ax.set_title("The Full 50-State Launch Is Tiny at Federal Scale", fontsize=20, weight="bold", pad=16)
launch_cost = format_parameter_value(float(STATE_RTT_PHILANTHROPIC_COST_TOTAL), "USD")
ax.set_xlabel(f"Hours of each annual budget equal to the {launch_cost} launch (log scale)", fontsize=12)
ax.text(
    0.5,
    -0.16,
    "Budget scale only. FDA and NIH bars do not estimate those agencies' cost-effectiveness.",
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    ha="center",
    va="top",
    fontsize=10,
)
clean_spines(ax)
ax.grid(axis="x", which="both", linestyle=":", alpha=0.35)
add_watermark(fig)

output_path = get_figure_output_path("state-rtt-government-budget-scale.png")
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor=COLOR_WHITE)
add_png_metadata(
    output_path,
    title="Universal Right to Trial Federal Budget Scale",
    description=f"Hours of selected annual federal budgets equal to the modeled {launch_cost} launch cost.",
)
plt.show()
```
